questions.question: Ministry of Finance introduced a new form called Form 26AS for:
questions.solution:
The correct answer is **__Tax Payers.__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__**

__
 
• ​​__Form 26AS, also known as Annual Information Statement (AIS).
 
• **​Form 26AS** to provide details of **pending/ completed income tax proceedings**, the **status of income tax demand and refund along** with details of specified financial transactions undertaken by the taxpayer during a financial year.
 
• **Form 26AS **expanded to incorporate 8 new particulars, **including foreign remittances, interest on income tax refund, off-market transactions, dividend income/ purchase of mutual funds, the detailed breakup of salary and information from Income Tax Return (ITR) of another person.**

** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] __Additional Information__**

 
• **​Form 26AS** was initially introduced as a tax credit statement, containing details of taxes deducted from the income of taxpayers (TDS/ TCS), advance tax or any self-assessment tax paid by the taxpayers or income tax refund received during the financial year.
 
• **Form 26AS** is the major mandatory document needed prior to furnishing the** income tax return (ITR).**

questions.question: Which of the following states had the highest per capita income for the year 2019-2020?
questions.solution:
The correct answer is** __Goa.__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __ Key Points__**

__
 
• The **Ministry of Statistics and Programme Implementation** (report released on 7 January 2020), the state per capita income of **Goa is the highest in the country.**
 
• **Bihar** has the lowest per capita income.
 
• The per-capita net national income of India rose to **Rs 1,35,050/annum in 2019-20.**
 
• This was **1,26,406 during 2018-19.**
 
• In terms of NSDP per capita (INR at Current prices), Goa has the highest per capita income Rs 467,998 in FY 2018-19.
 
• Delhi is in second place with Rs. 365,529.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Per capita income is the average income per head of population per period.
 
• Net national product (NNP) is gross national product (GNP), the total value of finished goods and services produced by a country's citizens overseas and domestically, minus depreciation.
 
• NNP is often examined on an annual basis as a way to measure a nation's success in continuing minimum production standards.
 
• It is computed by dividing the national income of the country by the total population, i.e. Per capita income = National Income ÷ Population
 
• It is used as a measure of the standard of living between countries.

questions.question: Good Governance Day is observed annually on 25 December on the birth anniversary of ______.
questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**Atal Bihari Vajpayee.**__

__** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] Key Points__**

__
 
• The Good Governance Day (GGD) is observed on December 25 of every year in India.
 
• The birth anniversary of former Prime Minister and Bharat Ratna Atal Bihari Vajpayee is celebrated as Good Governance Day across the country.
 
• The day aims to let the citizens, the students, who are the future of the country know about the government's responsibilities and duties that it needs to fulfill.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• Shri Atal Bihari Vajpayee was born on 25 December 1924 in Gwalior Madhya Pradesh.__
 
• He was one of the founding members of the Bharatiya Jana Sangh and later became its national president.
 
• Atal Bihari Vajpayee won the election from Lucknow parliamentary constituency and became the tenth Prime Minister of India.
 
• Atal Bihari Vajpayee has given his membership in both the Lok Sabha and the Rajya Sabha.
 
• He was awarded Bharat Ratna, India's highest honour in the year 2015.
 
• Atal Bihari Vajpayee was the first foreign minister of India who give a speech in Hindi at the United Nations.
 
• He died in Delhi on 16 August 2018 due to prolonged illness.

questions.question: Which of the following statements about blood pressure is correct?

options.text: The normal systolic pressure is about 80 mm of Hg and diastolic pressure is 120 mm of Hg.
The normal systolic pressure is about 120 mm of Hg and diastolic pressure is 80 mm of Hg.
The normal systolic pressure is about 160 mm of Hg and diastolic pressure is 80 mm of Hg.
The normal systolic pressure is about 72 mm of Hg and diastolic pressure is 35 mm of Hg.

questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**The normal systolic pressure is about 120 mm of Hg and diastolic pressure is 80 mm of Hg.**__

__** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] Key Points__**

__
 
• The normal blood pressure range is 120/80 mm. 
 
• The top number (120) is known as the systolic number while the bottom number (80) is known as the diastolic number.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__** 

 
• The blood pressure is measured by an instrument known as a sphygmomanometer.
 
• The study of blood is known as Haematology.
 
• The normal volume of blood in an adult human being is 4.7 to 5 litres.
 
• William Harvey was the first scientist to describe accurately how blood is pumped around the body by the heart.
 
• Karl Landsteiner classified the blood of human beings into A, B, AB, and O.
 
• Blood is purified mainly by lungs which remove gaseous impurities like CO2 and kidneys which remove other impurities.

questions.question: Which of the following was the first High Court established in India?
questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**Calcutta**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The first high court of India was established in **Calcutta**.
 
• It was formerly called the High Court of Judicature at Fort William.
 
• It was issued under the Indian High Courts Act 1861.
 
• It was formally opened on 1 July 1862.
 
• Sir Barnes Peacock as its first Chief Justice of the Calcutta High Court.
 
• Justice Sumboo Nath Pandit was the first Indian to assume office as a Judge of the Calcutta High Court.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• The Supreme Court in India was established under the Regulating Act, of 1773.
 
• The Regulating Act of 1773 established a Supreme Court at Fort William, Calcutta.
 
• Harilal Jekisundas Kania was the first Chief Justice of India.
 
• The Supreme Court of India came into existence on 26 January 1950.
 
• It replaced both the Federal Court of India and the Judicial Committee of the Privy Council.

questions.question: Who among the following was the captain of women's hockey team of India as of December 2020?
questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**Rani Rampal.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Rani Rampal is an Indian field hockey player from Haryana.
 
• She is currently the Captain of the Indian Women's Hockey Team.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• The Indian women’s Hockey team captain Rani Rampal is the World Games Athlete of the Year 2019, thus becoming the first-ever hockey player to win the prestigious World Games Athlete of the Year Award.
 
• In 2020 the Government of India honored her with the Padma Shri.
 
• Rani played in the Champion's Challenge Tournament held in Kazan, Russia in June 2009 and powered India to a win by scoring 4 goals in the finals.
 
• At the age of 15, she was the youngest player in the national team which participated in the 2010 World Cup.
